correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Lagrange-inversion integrality and a1=R, a2=R(2P+R-1)/2. For primes ell>2P+R, Lucas gives a_ell ≡P and a_2ell ≡P(2P-1) (mod ell); the Dold Möbius sums at ell and 2ell are P-R and P(P-1)/2. The second is a fixed positive integer on diagonal P=R>=2; any single scaling M fails for arbitrarily large ell. Exceptional P=R=1 is a constant fixed-point sequence. Independent exact integer tests checked P<=6, R<=7 and primes 17,19,23, without extrapolating those tests to the theorem.
residual_risks: Only positive integer Raney parameters and n>=1; obstruction checks necessary divisibility, not sufficiency for arbitrary sequences.
